# HexPiece 3.5.3

Sky Road's climbing steps (hold Space): each step is now one normal thin string under your foot, as thin as the swinging strings, with
only a tiny flash where your foot lands (3.5.2 drew three thick strings woven together). Everything else is as in 3.5.2. Not tested in
game yet: the build and the tests pass, and the steps were checked in previews.
